Global Commodity Manager Valves & Actuators

Job Title  Corporate Commodity Manager (f/m/d) Valves & Actuators Location: Germany, Sweden, US Department: SE P DM SYS RA Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis Mode of Employment: Full-time / Permanent A Snapshot of Your Day  The organization Strategic Procurement, Direct Material is responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies for direct materials and services that will ensure the optimization of Siemens Energy’s competitive position. As a Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, you will be part of Corporate Strategic Procurement team (SE P DM SYS RA), lead a cross-functional team globally and are responsible for a Corporate commodity strategy. Focus is on developing and managing a Valves & Actuator suppliers Typical day for Corporate Commodity Manager includes define/execution of commodity strategies, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, supplier contract management, reporting, problem solving and escalation handling, supply chain risk mitigation as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact  The successful candidate will be the Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, which includes: Manage commodity globally and across organizations and develop, implement, and maintain a global commodity strategy for Valves & Actuators, in alignment with business units. Conduct market analysis, cost structure analysis, and supply landscape evaluations. Identify cost‑saving opportunities, to include innovation pathways Maintain a strong external network of Valve & Actuator OEM’s, which include new supplier development. Identify, evaluate, and approve strategic suppliers based on capability, sustainability, quality, and cost. Build long‑term supplier relationships and lead supplier business reviews, scorecard evaluations, and follow-up actions. Ensure business continuity by preparing risk mitigation plans and dual/multi sourcing concepts. Internal and external management around demand vs supply in terms of capacity management. Internal and external management around market intelligence, which includes but is not limited to Market trends (cost drivers, M&A, demand). Geopolitical and supply chain risk impact, competitor and supplier landscape. Prepare and run quarterly business reviews / executive alignment Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing, terms, capacity and service agreements and manage framework contracts, SLAs, pricing and supply agreements. Ensure suppliers meet environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards. Be strong interface to lead commodity circles with R&D, Cost-Value Engineering, Supplier Quality Development as well as other procurement functions. What You Bring Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related field. 5–10 years’ experience in strategic procurement, preferably in Direct Materials in Energy, Oil & Gas, Process Industry. Packaging experience is strongly preferred. Strong commercial and negotiation skills. Knowledge in supply and supplier markets for Valves & Actuators. Operations experience (Manufacturing and SCM), ideally in a leadership position are a plus Excellent analytical capabilities and structured problem-solving. Strong stakeholder management capabilities across functions and regions. Ability to integrate and influence in a matrix organization and drive corporate initiatives Excellent knowledge of contract law and export control Knowledge in geo-political cost management strategies Fluent English; German and other languages are a plus Position is posted for Germany, Sweden, US Travel percentage ~25%   About the Team The SE P DM SYS RA organization is responsible for managing 3rd party spend as well as developing procurement strategies of direct material fields for Rotating Equipment and Auxiliaries that will allow Siemens Energy to maintain competitive position in marketplace and support company’s vision to become the most valued energy technology company Our professional procurement team utilizes modern tools and processes to develop global sourcing strategy for assigned commodities, that delivers optimal supply cost, quality, on time delivery, ESG (Environment, Social & Governance) compliant and VUCA resilient supply chain for Business Unit to improve competitive advantage for Siemens Energy.

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computer science, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in a unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. Some 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

jobs.description:
Where we need you

- Ensure stable and reliable operation of the SAP BW/BI landscape through proactive monitoring
- Analyze incidents, perform root cause analyses, and resolve system issues
- Maintain data accuracy and timeliness by overseeing data loads, transformations, and housekeeping
- Create analytical stories and support the transition to SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP DataSphere
- Provide 2nd-level support to business users, including SAP BPC troubleshooting
- Support SAP BI initiatives and S/4HANA transformation projects within the global SAP Competence Center
- Coordinate and collaborate with external consultants and partners
- Independently analyze and implement change requests with a strong focus on quality and accuracy

How to convince us

- Degree or comparable qualification in IT, (business) informatics, or business administration
- 5+ years of strong experience in SAP BW/BI, including process chain monitoring and troubleshooting
- Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP DataSphere with a minimum of 5 years of experience
- Strong analytical skills with a high level of diligence, precision, and quality focus
- Ability to work independently in incident management and implement changes end-to-end
- Proven experience collaborating with external consultants and IT service partners and initial project management experience is an advantage
- Good written and spoken English (minimum B2) and willingness to travel

What we offer

- An attractive family-owned company with 200 years of experience
- A competitive compensation package
- At least 30 days of vacation and flexible remote work arrangements
- A wide range of professional development opportunities
- Ergonomic workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Health and wellness initiatives
- Healthy and varied meal options in our cafeteria
- Jobrad and other attractive discounts

Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

Join our WLP FO expert development team within the Core Acquiring Tribe at Worldline, where you'll serve as a recognized domain expert for a specific area of the Worldline Pay Front Office authorization and switching systems. Working alongside fellow WLP FO experts and in close collaboration with the WLP FO Architects, this senior role combines deep technical C++ expertise with extensive business knowledge in financial authorization — requiring you to act as the go-to authority within your domain, a best-practices resource for the team, and a trusted bridge between business requirements and technical implementation.

Day-to-day responsibilities

- Serve as the recognized expert within your specific WLP FO domain — guiding teams and stakeholders through complex technical and business challenges, and acting as the primary point of reference for your area of expertise internally and externally
- Collaborate closely with the WLP FO Architects and fellow domain experts to ensure architectural coherence, standards alignment, and consistency of technical decisions across the broader WLP FO platform
- Lead and own the development of C++ software solutions within your domain for real-time electronic payment processing and authorization, championing best practices and technical quality
- Interpret complex business requirements within your domain and translate them into innovative, scalable technical solutions — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities, and escalating cross-domain implications to the WLP FO Architects where appropriate
- Define and own technical solutions and requirements for new WLP FO functionality within your scope, recommending best practices and driving alignment across product management, software architecture, and key stakeholders
- Champion the conceptual and technical integrity of payment authorization features within your domain, leading technical reviews and contributing to quality standards across the wider expert team
- Guide and formally mentor junior and mid-level team members on complex technical and business challenges within your domain, serving as the best-practices and quality resource
- Lead functional teams or projects within your WLP FO domain, coordinating cross-functional efforts and ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives in collaboration with the WLP FO Architects

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what's next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

- Recognized expertise in a specific WLP FO domain within payment authorization systems, with extensive experience in IT services and software development, advanced C++ programming skills, and deep knowledge of relational databases/SQL
- Proven ability to work collaboratively with architects and fellow domain experts,  contributing deep domain knowledge while maintaining awareness of cross-domain dependencies and architectural standards
- Proven ability to guide others through complex technical challenges within your domain — serving as a best-practices authority and quality resource within and beyond the team
- Strong business analysis capabilities with a track record of interpreting complex stakeholder requirements and translating them into innovative, scalable technical solutions
- Demonstrated experience leading functional teams or projects in Agile environments, managing cross-functional stakeholder expectations in complex international settings
- Excellent analytical, conceptual, and communication skills, with the ability to interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend solutions with broad organizational impact
- Deep expertise in the electronic payments sector, specifically in acquiring or issuing authorization systems, is strongly preferred
- Excellent English skills

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.
